description_en: Creates a service-linked role for Data Security Center (DSC) and authorizes DSC to access cloud resources
description_zh: 调用CreateSlrRole创建数据安全中心DSC（Data Security Center）的服务关联角色，授权DSC访问云资源
kebab_example: aliyun sddp create-slr-role --source-ip 106.11.XX.XX --feature-type 2 --lang zh_cn --service-name sddp.aliyuncs.com --api-version 2019-01-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSlrRole

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:
zh_cn: Simplified Chinese
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。取值：
zh_cn：中文（简体）
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The service name of the Alibaba Cloud service for which you want to create a service-linked role to associate with DSC
parameters.help_zh: 需要创建服务关联角色的阿里云服务名称
parameters.name: service_name

HasPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the service-linked role was created successfully. Valid values:
true: The role was created successfully.
false: The role failed to be created
HasPermission.description_zh:
服务关联角色是否创建成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
